```python
import torch, torchaudio, base64, io
from IPython.display import Markdown

samples = torch.sin(2 * torch.pi * 440 * torch.linspace(0, 1, 44100)) * 32767
buf = io.BytesIO()
torchaudio.save(buf, samples.short().unsqueeze(0), 44100, format='wav')
data = base64.b64encode(buf.getvalue()).decode()
html = f'<audio controls src="data:audio/wav;base64,{data}"></audio>'

Markdown(html)
```
